2609.02730.title: CORAL: An LLM-Native Harness for Production Recommender Systems
2609.02730.paper_summary: Production recommender systems shape what billions of people see, and sustaining their performance requires continual optimization: as content, user behavior, and upstream models shift, the choices governing retrieval, ranking, and serving must be revisited. Traditionally, human engineers test such changes through online experiments--a slow, reactive process limited by engineering effort, leaving parts of the system unrevised as conditions change. Although large language models have been applied to ranking, user modeling, and offline model development, few systems place an agent in a continual closed loop that acts on a live recommender and learns from the measured effects of its decisions. We present CORAL (Constraint-Optimized Recommender via an Agentic Loop), an LLM-native harness that closes this loop: each cycle, the agent observes operating signals, reasons over a memory of past decisions and outcomes, and invokes tools--including a numerical optimizer that keeps changes within a fixed operating budget--to reconfigure the recommender, with measured outcomes informing the next cycle. We formulate this as a partially observed, non-stationary, constrained optimization problem in which the policy improves in context, without parameter updates, from its prior actions. Across two large-scale social platforms, evaluated with A/B experiments, the same harness improves engagement at no additional serving cost on one and reduces serving cost without degrading engagement on the other, spanning the engagement-efficiency frontier. Performance improves as the loop iterates, suggesting that a single agentic loop can automate continual optimization work traditionally performed by human algorithm engineers under explicit guardrails.
2609.02730.paper_summary_zh: 生產推薦系統塑造了數十億人所見的內容，而維持其性能需要持續的優化：隨著內容、用戶行為和上游模型的變化，決定檢索、排序和提供的選擇必須重新檢視。傳統上，人類工程師通過在線實驗來測試這些變更——這是一個緩慢的、反應式的過程，受到工程努力的限制，隨著條件的變化，系統的某些部分未經修訂。儘管大型語言模型已應用於排序、用戶建模和離線模型開發，但很少有系統將代理放入一個持續的閉環中，該代理在實時推薦系統上行動並從其決策的測量效果中學習。我們提出了CORAL（通過代理循環的約束優化推薦系統），這是一個原生於LLM的工具，關閉了這個循環：每個循環中，代理觀察操作信號，根據過去的決策和結果的記憶進行推理，並調用工具——包括一個數值優化器，保持變更在固定的操作預算內——以重新配置推薦系統，測量的結果將指導下一個循環。我們將其表述為一個部分觀察的、非平穩的、受約束的優化問題，其中政策在上下文中改進，無需參數更新，基於其先前的行動。在兩個大型社交平台上進行的A/B實驗評估中，相同的工具在一個平台上提高了參與度而沒有額外的提供成本，而在另一個平台上則降低了提供成本而不降低參與度，跨越了參與度與效率的邊界。隨著循環的迭代，性能有所改善，這表明單一的代理循環可以自動化傳統上由人類算法工程師在明確的護欄下執行的持續優化工作。
